    if [[ $date_input =~ ^([0-9]{4})-([0-9]{1,2})-([0-9]{1,2})$ ]]; then

        month="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
        day="${BASH_REMATCH[3]}"
    # Check for M/D/YYYY or MM/DD/YYYY format
    elif [[ $date_input =~ ^([0-9]{1,2})/([0-9]{1,2})/([0-9]{4})$ ]]; then
        month="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
        day="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
        year="${BASH_REMATCH[3]}"
    else
        echo "Invalid date format"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    # Validate date ranges
    if [ $month -lt 1 ] || [ $month -gt 12 ] || [ $day -lt 1 ] || [ $day -gt 31 ]; then
        echo "Invalid date"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    # Pad with zeros
    month=$(printf "%02d" $month)
    day=$(printf "%02d" $day)
    
    echo "$year-$month-$day"
}

# Function to get month name
get_month_name() {
    local month_num=$1
    local full=$2
    
    case $month_num in
        01) if [ "$full" = "true" ]; then echo "January"; else echo "Jan"; fi ;;
        02) if [ "$full" = "true" ]; then echo "February"; else echo "Feb"; fi ;;
        03) if [ "$full" = "true" ]; then echo "March"; else echo "Mar"; fi ;;
        04) if [ "$full" = "true" ]; then echo "April"; else echo "Apr"; fi ;;
        05) if [ "$full" = "true" ]; then echo "May"; else echo "May"; fi ;;
        06) if [ "$full" = "true" ]; then echo "June"; else echo "Jun"; fi ;;
        07) if [ "$full" = "true" ]; then echo "July"; else echo "Jul"; fi ;;
        08) if [ "$full" = "true" ]; then echo "August"; else echo "Aug"; fi ;;
        09) if [ "$full" = "true" ]; then echo "September"; else echo "Sep"; fi ;;
        10) if [ "$full" = "true" ]; then echo "October"; else echo "Oct"; fi ;;
        11) if [ "$full" = "true" ]; then echo "November"; else echo "Nov"; fi ;;
        12) if [ "$full" = "true" ]; then echo "December"; else echo "Dec"; fi ;;
    esac
}

# Parse the input date
parsed_date=$(parse_date "$input_date")
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    exit 1
fi

# Extract components
year=$(echo $parsed_date | cut -d'-' -f1)
month=$(echo $parsed_date | cut -d'-' -f2)
day=$(echo $parsed_date | cut -d'-' -f3)

# Format the output
output="$format_string"
output=$(echo "$output" | sed "s/%Y/$year/g")
output=$(echo "$output" | sed "s/%y/${year:2:2}/g")
output=$(echo "$output" | sed "s/%m/$month/g")
output=$(echo "$output" | sed "s/%d/$day/g")
output=$(echo "$output" | sed "s/%B/$(get_month_name $month true)/g")
output=$(echo "$output" | sed "s/%b/$(get_month_name $month false)/g")

echo "$output"
EOF
